title: ST-depression–morphology interactions: selected-cohort transfer gain without stable refit evidence
abstract: In104 Hungarian patients with observed ST morphology,a Cleveland-trained model adding two ST-depression by morphology interactions improved Brier loss0.132737 to0.127249;source/target-refit95% interval for improvement[-0.003362,0.016431] includes zero,and all-row imputation reversed the point gain. Stable incremental utility was not established.
